scientific_integrity: The unique four-factor parameterization and unrestricted collision baseline are attributed to the cited literature. Finite enumeration supports, but does not establish, the asymptotic. No independent mathematical audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Fixed finite-field size, equal degrees, squarefree common product; the secondary coefficient is an absolutely convergent series, not an elementary closed form. Potential implicit coverage by general Euler-product coefficient theory remains.
title: A two-term asymptotic for squarefree-product multiplicative energy over polynomial rings
